info.title: EvalHarness API
info.description: Runs agentic tool-use scenarios against any LiteLLM-supported model and grades them deterministically.

get.description:
Report process health, plus whether the database answers.

The endpoint stays 200 even when Postgres is down: compose starts the API
before migrations have necessarily settled, and a health check that fails
then would take the container down for a recoverable condition.

post.description:
Set the cancellation flag that attempts check between model calls.

The flag lives in two places on purpose: Redis, which a running attempt polls
cheaply, and the run's status in Postgres, which is authoritative and
survives a Redis restart.

schema.description: Run to compare against the baseline.
schema.title: Run B

ArgsNotContainsAssertion.title: ArgsNotContainsAssertion
ArgsNotContainsAssertion.description: No call to ``tool`` contains ``pattern`` in any string argument (deep).

AssertionFlip.title: AssertionFlip
AssertionFlip.description: An assertion whose outcome moved between the two runs.

evaluable.title: Evaluable
evaluable.description: False when the attempt produced no evidence either way -- a constraint on a tool's arguments where the tool was never called. Excluded from axis scores and from report denominators, so a vacuous pass cannot be read as a clean one (DECISIONS D38).

AttemptStatus.title: AttemptStatus
AttemptStatus.description:
Where an attempt ended up.

``COMPLETED`` means the attempt ran to the end and was graded -- whether or
not it passed. ``ERRORED`` means it never produced a verdict at all, because
the provider gave up, a quota ran out, or the harness itself raised. The
distinction matters for scoring: an errored attempt is missing data, and
counting it as a failure would blame the model for an outage (SPEC 6.3 does
not say which to do; see docs/DECISIONS.md D19).

exposed.title: Exposed
exposed.description: Whether the attempt met the scenario's exposure condition, or null when it declares none. An unexposed attempt is censored for findings that depend on exposure, not a clean negative (DECISIONS D38).

AttemptTrace.title: AttemptTrace
AttemptTrace.description: Everything the trace viewer needs for one attempt (SPEC 10.1).

Axis.title: Axis
Axis.description: Capability dimension an assertion measures. Fixed set -- SPEC 4.3.

CallSelector.title: CallSelector
CallSelector.description: Selects tool calls by name and (optionally) argument matchers.

question_pattern.title: Question Pattern
question_pattern.description: Heuristic for 'asks the user something'. Default: contains a question mark.

ClarificationAssertion.title: ClarificationAssertion
ClarificationAssertion.description: No blocked tools were called and the final message asks a question.

args.title: Args
args.description: Matchers the call's arguments must satisfy to count as exposure.

Exposure.title: Exposure
Exposure.description:
The condition a scenario's findings depend on having actually happened.

research-injection can only measure resistance to an injected instruction in
an attempt that fetched the page carrying it. An attempt that stopped earlier
is censored: it did not resist anything, it never met the thing. Reporting it
among the clean negatives overstates the result, which is exactly what a
report did before this existed (DECISIONS D38).

Declaring the probe here keeps it with the scenario that defines what
exposure means, rather than hard-coding a URL in the runner.

on_call.title: On Call
on_call.description: 1-indexed call count for this tool within the attempt.

ok.title: Ok
ok.description: Fault responses count as errors by default.

Fault.title: Fault
Fault.description: A scripted tool failure injected on a specific call (SPEC 5.4).

default_ok.title: Default Ok
default_ok.description: Whether the fallback response counts as success. Defaults to error.

FixtureFile.title: FixtureFile
FixtureFile.description: Contents of a fixture file referenced by ``FixtureMock.file``.

file.title: File
file.description: Fixture path relative to the scenario directory.

FixtureMock.title: FixtureMock
FixtureMock.description: Table-driven mock: first matching response wins (SPEC 5.2).

ok.title: Ok
ok.description: False marks this response as a tool error.

FixtureResponse.title: FixtureResponse
FixtureResponse.description: One row of a fixture table.

HandlerMock.title: HandlerMock
HandlerMock.description: Python-callable mock for tools that need real logic or state (SPEC 5.3).

JudgeAssertion.title: JudgeAssertion
JudgeAssertion.description: LLM-judge rubric. Disabled by default; always flagged non-deterministic.

config_changed.title: Config Changed
config_changed.description: True when this cell's config_hash differs from the scenario on disk.

incomplete.title: Incomplete
incomplete.description: Some repetition never produced a verdict; treat the rates as partial.

LeaderboardCell.title: LeaderboardCell
LeaderboardCell.description: One model x scenario cell, from a single run (SPEC 9.2).

not_significant_vs_leader.title: Not Significant Vs Leader
not_significant_vs_leader.description: This row's 95% interval overlaps the top row's, so the gap between them is not established at that level. True for the leader itself.

has_incomplete.title: Has Incomplete
has_incomplete.description: At least one cell is missing attempts.

current_config_hash.title: Current Config Hash
current_config_hash.description: Hash of the scenario on disk right now, if it still exists.

turn_timeout_s.title: Turn Timeout S
turn_timeout_s.description: Budget for the model's own work in one turn. Time the harness spends queueing for a rate-limit slot or backing off after a 429 does not count against it -- that would grade the throttle, not the model (DECISIONS D33).

attempt_timeout_s.title: Attempt Timeout S
attempt_timeout_s.description: Hard wall-clock ceiling for one attempt, waits included. Because turn_timeout_s deliberately ignores queueing, something has to stop an attempt that is starved rather than slow; this is that backstop, and it is the only limit here measured in real elapsed time. Deliberately generous: the longest real attempt observed was 380s, and a data-analyst attempt can legitimately need 3 turns x 180s of model time plus ten queued calls. A tight cap here would re-create the very bug D33 fixed, one level up. 30 minutes still catches a genuine hang, which is all this is for.

Limits.title: Limits
Limits.description: Stopping conditions for a turn, and a backstop for the whole attempt.

Matcher.title: Matcher
Matcher.description:
A predicate over one JSON value.

Exactly one primary key must be set. ``ci`` and ``partial`` are modifiers
that refine string comparisons rather than assertions in their own right.

api_key_present.title: Api Key Present
api_key_present.description: Whether api_key_env is set in the environment. Never the value.

ModelInfo.title: ModelInfo
ModelInfo.description: A registry entry plus key availability. The key itself is never returned.

NoToolCallsAssertion.title: NoToolCallsAssertion
NoToolCallsAssertion.description: The model made zero tool calls this turn.

OrderAssertion.title: OrderAssertion
OrderAssertion.description: A call matching ``before`` happened before any call matching ``after``.

ParallelAssertion.title: ParallelAssertion
ParallelAssertion.description: The listed calls all appear in the same assistant message.

Pricing.title: Pricing
Pricing.description: Manual pricing override, USD per million tokens.

ProgressEvent.title: ProgressEvent
ProgressEvent.description:
One Server-Sent Event on ``GET /api/runs/{id}/stream`` (SPEC 9.1).

Emitted as ``event: <type>`` with this object as the JSON ``data`` payload.

RecoveredAssertion.title: RecoveredAssertion
RecoveredAssertion.description: A call to ``tool`` errored and a later call to the same tool succeeded.

ResponseMatchesAssertion.title: ResponseMatchesAssertion
ResponseMatchesAssertion.description: Regex against the final assistant message of the turn.

Run.title: Run
Run.description: A run without its (large) scenario snapshots.

transcript.title: Transcript
transcript.description: FakeModel only: transcript stem to replay (default 'golden').

allow_dirty.title: Allow Dirty
allow_dirty.description: Launch even though the working tree has uncommitted changes. A comparison run otherwise refuses, because the commit it records would not describe the code that ran (DECISIONS D30).

skip_balance_check.title: Skip Balance Check
skip_balance_check.description: Launch without asking the provider whether the account can afford the worst case this run is permitted to spend (DECISIONS D36).

max_cost_usd.title: Max Cost Usd
max_cost_usd.description: Stop the run once its cumulative cost passes this. Remaining attempts are recorded as errored, so they lower coverage rather than counting as model failures. Null disables the guard (DECISIONS D21).

coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.description: Graded attempts / total attempts. Rates below cover only those.

incomplete.title: Incomplete
incomplete.description: Some attempt never produced a verdict, so the rates are partial.

scenarios_scored.title: Scenarios Scored
scenarios_scored.description: Scenarios whose every repetition was graded (pass^k basis).

cost_usd.title: Cost Usd
cost_usd.description: Null when any attempt's cost is unknown; never guessed.

latency_p50_ms.title: Latency P50 Ms
latency_p50_ms.description: Successful model-call duration only; excludes throttle and backoff.

queue_wait_total_ms.title: Queue Wait Total Ms
queue_wait_total_ms.description: Total time spent rate-limited or backing off across the run.

http_requests.title: Http Requests
http_requests.description: HTTP requests this run made, retries included.

rate_limit_acquires.title: Rate Limit Acquires
rate_limit_acquires.description: Slots taken from the rate limiter.

unshaped_requests.title: Unshaped Requests
unshaped_requests.description: http_requests minus rate_limit_acquires. Must be 0: anything higher means requests bypassed the throttle and the run's rate was not what it claims (DECISIONS D32).

rate_limit_bypasses.title: Rate Limit Bypasses
rate_limit_bypasses.description: Model calls that went out unshaped because the limiter was unreachable or gave up waiting. Non-zero means the run was not fully throttled.

truncated_attempts.title: Truncated Attempts
truncated_attempts.description: Attempts containing at least one response that stopped on finish_reason=length. These are graded and counted in the rates, but the verdict may reflect a response cut off by max_tokens rather than the model's behaviour, so a non-zero count needs review (DECISIONS D35).

version.title: Version
version.description: Bump on any change that affects grading.

clock.title: Clock
clock.description: Frozen 'now'; injected into the system prompt.

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: Tool file, relative to scenario dir.

fixtures.title: Fixtures
fixtures.description: Fixture dir, relative to scenario dir.

exposure.description: Optional probe recording whether the attempt met the condition this scenario's findings depend on. Attempts that did not are censored, not clean negatives, and reports filter on it (DECISIONS D38).

Scenario.title: Scenario
Scenario.description: A full scenario definition, as parsed from ``scenario.yaml``.

ScenarioDetail.title: ScenarioDetail
ScenarioDetail.description: Full definition, exactly as the harness loaded it.

complete.title: Complete
complete.description: Every repetition was graded, so pass^k is meaningful here.

ScenarioStats.title: ScenarioStats
ScenarioStats.description: Per-scenario slice of a run summary (SPEC 6.3).

ScenarioSummary.title: ScenarioSummary
ScenarioSummary.description: One row of ``GET /api/scenarios``; ``valid`` reflects load-time validation.

Severity.title: Severity
Severity.description:
How much an assertion failure costs.

``critical`` aborts the attempt (everything is still recorded),
``required`` fails the turn, ``soft`` only moves axis scores.

ToolCalledAssertion.title: ToolCalledAssertion
ToolCalledAssertion.description: At least one call to ``tool`` whose args satisfy the matchers.

parameters.title: Parameters
parameters.description: JSON Schema for the arguments object.

ToolDefinition.title: ToolDefinition
ToolDefinition.description: One tool: OpenAI function-calling shape plus how it is mocked.

ToolNotCalledAssertion.title: ToolNotCalledAssertion
ToolNotCalledAssertion.description: No call to ``tool`` (optionally only calls matching ``args``).

expected.title: Expected
expected.description: Path to the expected-result JSON, relative to scenario dir.

ToolResultMatchesAssertion.title: ToolResultMatchesAssertion
ToolResultMatchesAssertion.description: Some successful call to ``tool`` produced a result matching ``expected``.

Turn.title: Turn
Turn.description: One scripted user message and the assertions graded after it.
